titolo: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
descr: Gondola reports revenue doubling as Codex raises its lead engineer’s productivity, while ChatGPT streamlines daily tasks.
paragrafi: The company says Codex lifted its lead engineer’s output by half, improving development speed.
ChatGPT is also used by the team to simplify routine work, further supporting productivity gains.
The revenue jump reflects the value of AI‑assisted tools for creative‑focused businesses.
Gondola’s experience underscores the commercial impact of integrating large language models into daily workflows.
perche: For AI users, the case shows how code‑generation models can accelerate development and reduce costs. Free‑model enthusiasts can note that while paid tools drive revenue, community‑ranked free chat models like Kimi K3 still lead in user preference.
